policy: Requested scene families resolve through this registry ONLY. AVAILABLE families render their scene; UNAVAILABLE families render an explicit UNAVAILABLE state. There is no default-scene fallback, no substitution, and no placeholder render for an unready family. Scene expansion beyond school-treatment-room-v1 is frozen until the quality program (C2/C3/C5) proves the existing slice.

school-treatment-room.notes: The existing vertical slice. Status caveats ride visibly (casualty Gate B PASS_PENDING_LIFECYCLE_REVIEW; chair Gate C PASS_PENDING_USER_REVIEW_FOR_ADMISSION).

drowning.reason: No semantically fitting drowning scene exists. Scene expansion is frozen; substituting the treatment room for a drowning scenario is forbidden (no wrong-scene fallback).
drowning.reasonHe: הסצנה אינה זמינה: סצנת טביעה מתאימה טרם נבנתה. הרחבת הסצנות קפואה, ואין להציג את חדר הטיפול כתחליף לתרחיש טביעה.

synagogue.reason: No synagogue scene exists. Recognizability cannot be claimed for a scene that has not been built and gated; registry stays honest (UNAVAILABLE), never a placeholder render.
